llms: the first human spaceflights 1961–65 — Gagarin's Vostok 1 minute by minute (ESA timeline), Allen–Eggers ballistic re-entry and its 8 g, the orbital-decay safety net (US Standard Atmosphere 1976 drag model reproduces the ~20-day figure), Titov and the group flights, Tereshkova, Voskhod 1 without spacesuits, and Leonov's spacewalk with an inflated-tube model of his ballooning Berkut suit.
